QuestInfo.name: Maya's Recipe
QuestInfo.1: Getting Camila's salad reminded Maya that she has an old recipe from her deceased mother. Since Maya isn't interested in cooking, she asked you to deliver that recipe to Camila.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered Maya's recipe to Camila. She looks pretty interested in it.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 300 Can proceed to the Making Horny Mushroom Pie quest

0.0: So, Camila's really into cooking now? *Cough* Maybe I should give her this. My mother came up with this recipe before she passed... My mother really loved cooking, but I've never been interested in it. Could you take this to her, as my thanks for the nice salad?\r\n

yes.0: Thank you. I hope Camila likes it. *Cough*

no.0: Do you think she won't like this recipe? Oh... That's too bad...

1.0: Hey, you're back. So... Did Maya like it? She liked it, right\r\n#L0##bOh, yes. She said it was very tasty, and asked me to give you this.#l\n#k
1.1: This? What is it?\r\n#L0##bMaya's mother's recipe. Maya thinks you might like to try it.#l\n#k
1.2: Wow, really? I'm just...wow. I'm so happy! Not only did she like my salad, but she gave me this! This might be the greatest day of my life!

npc.0: I hope Camila enjoys the recipe I gave her. I'm kind of curious what it tastes like, too. *Cough*

item.0: How did it go? Did Maya like my dish? She did, right? If she didn't, you can lie to me. It's okay.

lost.0: Hey, you forgot to take the recipe. Please take it to Camila, and tell her that I enjoyed her salad very much.
